name: zinterp_context_read_line_or_prepared_tokens
description: zInterp_Context::ReadLineOrPreparedTokens reads either a text script line into the caller buffer or a prepared token packet into tempAlloc/tokenList.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1160 validates the hasPreparedInput flag at context offset 0x94, text-mode fgetc loop into the supplied line buffer until newline/EOF flags, prepared-mode tokenReadIndex store at 0x0c, tokenCount at 0x08, tempAlloc at 0x1c, tokenList at 0x20, packet layout of tokenBlobSize/tokenCount/blob, and NUL-separated token pointer fix-up.
The native smokes verify text-line copying through newline, prepared-token packet allocation and tokenList fix-up, and zero-size prepared packet rejection with token state cleared.
